author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Winter pine: snowy needle spray atlas
description: Original procedural RGBA pine sprig: fine needles and broken snow coverage. Alpha-test at 0.45, double-sided, sRGB. Use on crossed branch cards. Generated without photographs from scripts/make-northwoods-textures.mjs; CC0.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Winter pine: procedural bark texture
description: Original 512px procedural brown-gray vertical bark furrows. sRGB albedo; optionally reuse as bump at low strength. No photographs. CC0 source generator included.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Northwoods: deterministic ecology WFC & terrain
description: Renderer-independent weighted entropy wave function collapse with adjacency propagation and bounded deterministic restarts; pine, mixed, maple and glade patches. A continuous carved trail, analytic rolling terrain, stable tree transforms and glacial erratic landmark. Same seed and options generate identical data for peer-to-peer worlds. Throws on contradictory rules. Original code dedicated to CC0.

exports.name: attach
exports.does: Generate an immutable-by-convention layout for any renderer.

exports.name: generate
exports.does: Seeded ecology grid, tree transforms, spawn, landmarks, heightAt and trailX.

exports.name: collapse
exports.does: Generic weighted tile constraint solver, with custom grammar and fixed cells.

options.name: seed
options.does: Layout identity; transmit once to peers.

options.name: tiles
options.does: Each tile has id, positive weight and neighbors; use known biome IDs with generate, any IDs with collapse.

hooks.name: path
hooks.does: Replace continuous trail centerline; default trailX.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Northwoods: branching winter tree generator
description: Original geometry generator for snow-laden red-pine-inspired conifers and scraggly leafless sugar-maple-inspired hardwoods. Radial branch whorls, secondary needle sprays, recursive hardwood forks and snow pillows. Separate vertex-colored bark, needle and snow meshes support instancing, recoloring and GLB export. Botanical approximations, no external textures.

exports.name: attach
exports.does: Create, attach and own a tree.

exports.name: makeTree
exports.does: Generate a stand-alone tree in meters, rooted at origin.

options.name: needleTexture
options.does: Optional alpha-tested pine atlas (baked snow coverage).

options.name: detail
options.does: 1 for full branches; less than 1 uses fewer pine whorls and shallower maple forks for distant instances.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Northwoods: instanced snowy forest renderer
description: Three.js forest world with distance-selected instanced branch detail and batched tree variants, rolling vertex-colored snow terrain, optional scanned snow map, footsteps, glacial rocks, snowfall, fog, hemisphere lighting and camera-following sun shadows. Accepts pure layout data and a replaceable tree factory. No network side effects beyond the optional supplied texture URL.

exports.name: attach
exports.does: Build renderable winter environment; ready resolves after optional texture attempt.

options.name: snowTexture
options.does: Optional repeatable snow albedo; a procedural fallback renders immediately.

options.name: needleTexture
options.does: Shared original pine spray atlas, caller-owned.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Snow walker: terrain-following first-person controller
description: First-person WASD/arrows walking, Shift hurry, collision sliding against tree circles and bounds, terrain following, gentle step bob, footsteps, mouse drag and optional pointer lock, touch input methods, focus-loss key cleanup and disposal. Works in opaque sandboxed game iframes without pointer lock permission.

exports.name: attach
exports.does: Attach camera movement and input lifecycle.

hooks.name: onStep
hooks.does: Footstep audio, decals or replicated events.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Winter: synthesized wind & snow footsteps
description: Sample-free Web Audio winter soundscape. Low-pass wind noise and short crunchy footfalls, user-gesture start, volume, suspend/resume and complete disposal. All sound generated locally; no recordings.

exports.name: attach
exports.does: Create sound engine lazily, on first start.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Snow-laden red pine
description: Original CC0 branching geometry, generated from northwoods-trees (seed 50). Root at origin, Y up, meters. Embedded original CC0 procedural textures and separate meshes for bark, snow and needles. Rebuild or change branch structure with scripts/make-northwoods-assets.mjs. Botanical approximation.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Bare winter sugar maple
description: Original CC0 branching geometry, generated from northwoods-trees (seed 50). Root at origin, Y up, meters. Embedded original CC0 procedural textures and separate meshes for bark, snow. Rebuild or change branch structure with scripts/make-northwoods-assets.mjs. Botanical approximation.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Where the Pines Keep Winter
description: An unhurried first-person winter walk through a procedurally grown northern Wisconsin inspired forest. Snow-laden pines, bare maples, rolling snow, glacial stones, falling flakes, footprints and synthesized wind and crunching footsteps. Weighted-entropy WFC ecology, deterministic seeds, instanced geometry and continuous trail. WASD/arrows, drag to look, Shift to hurry; touch controls. Five reusable CC0 logic modules and two stand-alone tree models published alongside. Solo demonstration; deterministic layout is ready for peer-to-peer remixes.

title: Northwoods: complete CC0 remix kit
description: Portable source starter for Where the Pines Keep Winter. Includes five editable logic modules, snowy pine and bare maple GLBs, original needle and bark texture generators, scanned CC0 Poly Haven snow, rebuild scripts, a runnable walking demo and detailed WFC/P2P composition guide. Run node prepare.mjs and serve the folder. No install required for the demo; rebuilding GLBs requires three@0.170.0. Solo demo; transport not included.
author: the internet slop warehouse; snow texture by Poly Haven
